value.rationale: Strengthens physically motivated but only pointwise/asymptotic speed-response observations into a global stochastic comparative-statics theorem for every radius. Any single threshold exceedance identifies return speed for each non-Poisson Gamma shape, while the sharp shape-one boundary makes such identification impossible. This has distinct statistical and physical meaning beyond formula recomputation.
